semantics: No retry policy, revision counter, lock or mutation lifecycle is implemented here. acceptCurrent is caller supplied, defaults true, and guards loaded entities per projection; it does not guard inbox projections or all stale-key decisions.
applyIssueChange synchronously snapshots and patches; it returns staleKeys without invalidating those keys. Inbox helper preserves prior invalidation with refetchType none.
rollback restores captured snapshots without revision admission or concurrency arbitration; undefined detail/inbox snapshots are skipped; archive snapshot tuples are replayed.

invalidateStaleListKeys deduplicates hashKey within one invocation. Inbox exact cancelQueries promise chains exact invalidation; function returns without awaiting chains. Other invalidations are unawaited.
